title: Controlled empirical characterization of sharpness aware minimization for synthetic to real transfer in LiDAR semantic segmentation: code and raw evaluation results
description:
Training, evaluation, control, probe, analysis, and figure code, the raw per-run evaluation files (423 JSON files across 63 runs), the unedited job logs, and the frozen-protocol manifest for a controlled empirical study of sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) in synthetic-to-real LiDAR semantic segmentation (SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI, SemanticSTF, and SemanticPOSS), including a BatchNorm recalibration control, a compute control, a loss-landscape perturbation probe, and a development-independent SemanticPOSS evaluation.

Every number, table, and data figure in the article can be regenerated from the JSON files without a GPU. Trained checkpoints (55 files, 2.6 GB) are not included; their SHA-256 hashes are recorded in POSS_FREEZE_MANIFEST.md. The datasets are not redistributed.

Requires Python 3, PyTorch with CUDA, spconv, numpy, scipy, and matplotlib.
